title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Form 1099-G Statement Terms
content:
A Form 1099-G is issued for each Unemployment Benefit Claims record on which benefits were paid in a calendar tax year, by the issue deadline of the following year.

## Boxes

| Box | Amount reported |
|---|---|
| Box 1 | Payments issued in the tax year by payment date, gross of overpayment offsets and income tax withholding, less payments cancelled in the same year and less overpayments repaid in the same tax year |
| Box 4 | Federal income tax withheld from those payments |
| Box 11 | State income tax withheld from those payments |

A repayment made in a later year does not change the earlier statement.

## Corrected statements

A corrected statement is issued when the original is wrong, for one of these reasons:

| Correction reason | When it applies |
|---|---|
| Identity theft | The claim was filed by an impostor; the corrected statement reports zero in every box |
| Payment reversal | Payments were cancelled after issue |
| Overpayment repaid same year | An overpayment was repaid in the same tax year |
| Withholding misreported | Withholding was misreported |

- An identity theft correction is issued only when the identity verification case linked to the claim has status fraud confirmed, as the Claimant Identity Verification record shows it.
- A correction may be requested only for a tax year within the correction lookback years before the current year.
- Each correction is a new statement record and the original is never edited.

### Hypothetical Box 1

Payments of 5200.00 issued in a tax year, 400.00 of them cancelled in that year and 300.00 of overpayment repaid in that year, give Box 1 of 4500.00; a further 200.00 repaid the next year leaves that statement unchanged.
